//go:build (linux || darwin) && arm64 && !tinygo
#include "textflag.h"
#include "funcdata.h"
#include "go_asm.h"
TEXT ·inlineHostIntegerScalarPrototypeEnter(SB), NOSPLIT, $64-80
	NO_LOCAL_POINTERS
	MOVD ZR, ret+72(FP)
	MOVD code+8(FP), R9
	MOVD args+16(FP), R0
	MOVD linMem+24(FP), R1
	MOVD trap+32(FP), R2
	MOVD results+40(FP), R3
	MOVD stack+48(FP), R10
	ADR goCallback, R12
	BL ·inlineHostIntegerEnterForeign(SB)
	RET
goCallback:
	MOVD ctrl+56(FP), R10
	MOVD 32(RSP), R11
	CMP R10, R11
	BNE abortAdmission
	MOVD const_hcImportIdx(R10), R11 // import index and raw slots
	MOVWU slots+64(FP), R12
	LSL $32, R12, R12
	CMP R12, R11
	BNE abortAdmission
	MOVD trap+32(FP), R9
	MOVWU 0(R9), R11
	CBNZ R11, abortTrap
	MOVD fn+0(FP), R26
	MOVD 0(R26), R9
	MOVD const_hcArgs(R10), R0
	MOVD const_hcArgs+8(R10), R1
	BL (R9)
	MOVD trap+32(FP), R9
	MOVWU 0(R9), R11
	CBNZ R11, abortTrap
	MOVD ctrl+56(FP), R10
	MOVWU slots+64(FP), R11
	LSR $16, R11, R11
	CBZ R11, resultDone
	CMP $1, R11
	BNE twoResults
	MOVD R0, const_hcResults(R10)
	B resultDone
twoResults:
	MOVWU R0, R12
	LSR $32, R0, R13
	MOVD R12, const_hcResults(R10)
	MOVD R13, const_hcResults+8(R10)
resultDone:
	MOVD $·inlineHostIntegerStagedBridge(SB), R9
	MOVD R9, const_hcTrampoline(R10)
	MOVD 40(RSP), R9
	MOVD 32(RSP), R11
	JMP ·inlineHostIntegerResumeForeign(SB)
abortAdmission:
	MOVD $1, R9
	MOVD R9, ret+72(FP)
	RET
abortTrap:
	MOVD $2, R9
	MOVD R9, ret+72(FP)
	// Return directly through the normal Go owner epilogue. No foreign
	// continuation executes after cancellation or an admission violation.
	RET
